finding.description: The nine-field branch verifies a pin using exact_pin() and then independently reopens the path to decode a second bounded raw buffer. The second buffer is compared semantically with metadata but is not SHA256-bound to the declared terminal_frame pin. A between-open path/content change can make the hash observation and decoded fields refer to different byte snapshots. No race fixture was executed.
finding.minimal_repair: In an immutable successor, require len(raw)==terminal_frame.bytes and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==terminal_frame.sha256 for the actual bounded buffer passed to struct.unpack; preferably obtain stable identity and bounded bytes in a single verification/read scope. Keep V1/V2/V3 files and findings unchanged.
